sum: Top Wealth Group Holding Limited provides caviar and caviar-based gourmet products worldwide. The company trades in caviars; and wine and health products. It serves food and beverage related distributors. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Sai Wan, Hong Kong. Top Wealth Group Holding Limited operates as a subsidiary of Winwin Development Group Limited.
ceo: Mr. Yuen Cheong Carp  Lee (CEO & Deputy Chairman)
